'''Rose Maanki''' was a [[Color/Legends|red]]-haired [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] who took part in a [[Dromund Kaas rebellion|slave uprising]] near the [[Unfinished colossus]] outside of [[Kaas City]], on the Sith Empire capital world of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
